executionPlan: Read constitution, QA insights, stage contract, round 1 QA report and dev reports 05 and 10. Ran lint, test and build on Node 22 myself (build in a rsync copy of the tree with node_modules symlinked so the dev server .next was untouched). Inspected the working-tree diff against f8da3ab (stat, name filter for protected files, scripted em dash and machine-path scan over every modified and untracked text file, package.json and lock diff). Mutation check: copied the tree, put the f8da3ab player.ts into the copy only (no stash, reset or checkout) and ran the physics test file. Browser: headless Chrome via DevTools protocol against the running dev server (software GL), held keys through Input.dispatchKeyEvent, avatar position read from the three scene, active animation clips read by wrapping AnimationMixer.update through the webpack module cache, bone heights read from the scene. Reran the bake script from the original pulled from git (a891bc4) and compared bytes. Hero checks in a separate session. All scripts and screenshots are in the scratchpad qa/m1-r2 directory. Playwright MCP was not used (it can only tap keys).
summary: REJECTED on one important finding. Gates are green (lint 0, 100 tests in 6 files, build 0 with / at 125 kB), diff scope is clean, F1 and F2 are confirmed fixed (peak-height test fails 6 of 6 on the f8da3ab player.ts), straight walk and run, idle, jump and fall look right, and the bake is byte-identical and refuses a baked input. The hard landing clip is visibly wrong: when the avatar lands from a 1.6 to 4 m drop, the land clip plays with the hips pinned at standing height (Hips tracks are stripped) so the legs are tucked up and the toes sit 0.84 to 0.95 m above the ground while the capsule is grounded; it looks like sitting in mid air (screenshots hardland-land-0 to hardland-land-2). Criterion 4 therefore fails. Also reported: camera hidden inside the ramp slabs during drops (minor), and a few 1 px skin-coloured specks at the hero collar and sleeve hem (minor). The faint stripes on the hero shirt are the intended CSS scanline overlay, not shadow acne.

Fails: the hard landing pose is defective, see F1 (hardland-land-0.png to hardland-land-2.png, sheet-hardland.png). Foot sliding: judged acceptable by construction and by screenshots (playback rate follows speed over clip speed, 2.2 over 1.54 for walk and 4.8 over 4.86 for run, no visible skating in the captured frames); a numeric measurement was not obtained because software GL ran at about 8 fps under polling, so the speed under test was below nominal (walk about 1.1 m/s, run about 3.3 m/s); this is an honest gap, not a pass of the numeric measurement.

findings.file: scripts/strip-clips.mjs and components/game/animator.ts (land clip, Hips tracks dropped)
findings.line: strip-clips.mjs Hips drop (ASSETS.md line 81); animator.ts enter() 'land' at 118-143
findings.trigger: Walk off the end or side of ramp-30 from 1.5 m or higher (or any drop with impact speed of 6.5 m/s or more), hold nothing, watch the land state (about 0.5 to 1.1 s).
findings.consequence: The Hard Landing clip is played rotation-only with the Hips translation removed, so the crouch depth is lost: the hips stay at standing height (0.984 m) while the legs fold up, and the feet end up 0.84 to 0.95 m above the ground while the capsule is grounded. The avatar looks seated in mid air on every hard landing, the main new feature of this round.
findings.evidence: Trace at rootY=0: hips=0.984, lf=0.924, rf=0.878, ltoe=0.945, rtoe=0.839 in the land state; screenshots hardland-land-0.png, hardland-land-1.png, hardland-land-2.png, sheet-hardland.png. Fix direction (not made by QA): keep a vertical Hips offset for land (for example derive the hips drop from the source clip and apply it to the avatar root or the hips) or select a landing clip whose crouch is carried by rotations, then re-measure the foot height against the ground.

screenshotLocation: scratchpad qa/m1-r2 directory of the session (not in the repo)
assumptions: The OPENAI_API_KEY is deliberately absent in the local dev environment, so a session request that returns a server error still counts as 'talk starts a session request'.
Numeric foot sliding could not be measured because software GL runs at about 8 fps while polling; judged by construction (playback rate equals speed over clip speed) and visually.
The hard landing visual defect is attributed to dropping the Hips translation track, based on ASSETS.md line 81 and the measured hips height; the exact fix is for the owning dev.
decisionsProposed: Fix round 2 should restore a hips height drop for the land clip (or pick another clip) and add a test that checks the lowest and highest foot height in the land state against the ground.
lessonsProposed: Dropping Hips tracks from a Mixamo clip is safe for locomotion but not for a crouch or landing: assert foot height against the ground for every clip that changes stance, not only that the clip plays.

In headless software GL, polling per frame slows the app below 10 fps and scales speeds down; read animation state by wrapping AnimationMixer.update through the webpack module cache and sample on the page side rather than from the driver.
